leaves.leaf: Abstract vector spaces, linear maps, dual and quotient spaces
leaves.scope: Axioms and constructions of finite- and infinite-dimensional vector spaces: subspaces, bases, Hamel bases, dimension, the Steinitz exchange lemma, rank–nullity, isomorphism theorems, direct sums, quotient spaces, dual and double-dual spaces and annihilators.
queries: vector space axioms Hamel basis dimension
rank nullity theorem kernel image linear map
dual space annihilator double dual isomorphism
quotient space direct sum complementary subspace

leaves.leaf: Gaussian elimination and LU, Cholesky and LDLᵀ factorizations
leaves.scope: Direct solution of linear systems: row echelon forms, Gauss–Jordan elimination, Doolittle/Crout LU, Cholesky and LDLᵀ factorizations, partial/complete/rook pivoting, growth factors and operation counts.
queries: Gaussian elimination partial pivoting growth factor
LU decomposition Doolittle Crout permutation matrix
Cholesky decomposition LDL factorization flops
reduced row echelon form Gauss Jordan elimination

leaves.leaf: Determinants and determinant identities
leaves.scope: Definitions and properties of the determinant, including the Leibniz and Laplace expansions, cofactors and the adjugate, Cramer's rule, Cauchy–Binet, the Sylvester and Desnanot–Jacobi identities, and Dodgson condensation.
queries: Leibniz formula determinant permutations sign
Laplace expansion cofactor minors adjugate matrix
Cauchy Binet formula Sylvester determinant identity
Dodgson condensation Desnanot Jacobi identity

leaves.leaf: Eigenvalues, diagonalization and the spectral theorem
leaves.scope: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors, characteristic polynomials, algebraic versus geometric multiplicity, diagonalizability and similarity, Schur triangularization, and the spectral theorems for normal, Hermitian and unitary matrices.
queries: characteristic polynomial algebraic geometric multiplicity eigenvalue
diagonalizable matrix eigenbasis similarity transformation
spectral theorem normal matrix unitary diagonalization
Schur decomposition upper triangular unitary similarity

leaves.leaf: Jordan and rational canonical forms and minimal polynomials
leaves.scope: Canonical forms under similarity, covering Jordan blocks and generalized eigenvectors, Weyr form, rational (Frobenius) canonical form, companion matrices, invariant factors, elementary divisors, minimal polynomials, the Cayley–Hamilton theorem and nilpotent matrices.
queries: Jordan normal form Jordan block generalized eigenvectors
rational canonical form Frobenius companion matrix
minimal polynomial invariant factors elementary divisors
Cayley Hamilton theorem nilpotent matrix index

leaves.leaf: Inner product spaces, orthogonality and projections
leaves.scope: Real and complex inner products, the Cauchy–Schwarz and triangle inequalities, orthonormal bases, Gram–Schmidt orthonormalization, orthogonal complements and projections, adjoints, Bessel/Parseval identities and Riesz representation in finite dimensions.
queries: inner product space Cauchy Schwarz inequality
Gram Schmidt orthonormalization process basis
orthogonal projection orthogonal complement subspace
Riesz representation adjoint operator inner product

leaves.leaf: Positive definite matrices, Schur complements and the Loewner order
leaves.scope: Theory of Hermitian positive (semi)definite matrices: Sylvester's criterion, Gram matrices, Schur complements and block inversion, the Loewner partial order, operator monotone functions, the Schur product theorem and matrix means.

Schur complement block matrix inversion formula
Loewner order operator monotone function
Schur product theorem Hadamard product positive semidefinite

leaves.leaf: Singular value decomposition, polar decomposition and low-rank approximation
leaves.scope: The SVD and its history (Beltrami, Jordan, Eckart–Young), properties of singular values, polar decomposition, the Eckart–Young–Mirsky theorem, truncated SVD, and Golub–Kahan bidiagonalization-based SVD algorithms.
queries: singular value decomposition history Beltrami Jordan
Eckart Young Mirsky theorem low rank approximation
polar decomposition unitary positive semidefinite factor
Golub Kahan bidiagonalization SVD algorithm

leaves.leaf: Least squares, QR factorization and pseudoinverses
leaves.scope: Overdetermined and underdetermined systems solved via normal equations, Householder, Givens and modified Gram–Schmidt QR, the Moore–Penrose pseudoinverse and its Penrose conditions, Tikhonov regularization and total least squares.

Householder reflection Givens rotation QR decomposition
Moore Penrose pseudoinverse Penrose conditions
Tikhonov regularization total least squares

leaves.leaf: Matrix norms, conditioning and floating-point error analysis
leaves.scope: Vector and matrix norms (induced, Frobenius, Schatten, Ky Fan), condition numbers, forward and backward error, Wilkinson-style rounding error analysis, the stability of algorithms, and iterative refinement including mixed precision.

condition number matrix inversion sensitivity
backward error analysis Wilkinson floating point
iterative refinement mixed precision linear systems

leaves.leaf: Eigenvalue localization, inequalities and perturbation theory
leaves.scope: Bounds on and perturbations of eigenvalues and invariant subspaces: Gershgorin discs, Courant–Fischer min-max, Cauchy interlacing, Weyl and Bauer–Fike inequalities, the Davis–Kahan sin-theta theorem, majorization, Schur–Horn, and Horn's conjecture.
queries: Gershgorin circle theorem eigenvalue bounds
Courant Fischer min max Cauchy interlacing
Weyl inequality Bauer Fike perturbation eigenvalues
Schur Horn theorem majorization Horn conjecture

leaves.leaf: Numerical algorithms for the eigenvalue problem
leaves.scope: Computing eigenvalues and eigenvectors: power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration, Hessenberg reduction, the Francis QR algorithm with shifts and deflation, the Jacobi method, divide-and-conquer, MRRR, and Lanczos/Arnoldi methods for large problems.

power iteration Rayleigh quotient inverse iteration
Lanczos algorithm Arnoldi iteration eigenvalues
Jacobi eigenvalue algorithm divide and conquer

leaves.leaf: Iterative solvers for linear systems and preconditioning
leaves.scope: Stationary methods (Jacobi, Gauss–Seidel, SOR), Krylov subspace methods (conjugate gradient, MINRES, GMRES, BiCGSTAB, QMR) and their convergence theory, and preconditioners such as incomplete LU/Cholesky and multigrid.

GMRES Krylov subspace method restarted
Jacobi Gauss Seidel successive over relaxation
incomplete LU preconditioner algebraic multigrid

leaves.leaf: Sparse matrix storage, orderings and sparse direct solvers
leaves.scope: Sparse matrix formats (COO, CSR, CSC, ELLPACK), fill-in and elimination trees, bandwidth and fill-reducing orderings (Cuthill–McKee, AMD, nested dissection), sparse direct solver packages, and the SuiteSparse/Matrix Market test collections.

leaves.leaf: Numerical linear algebra software libraries and benchmarks

matrix logarithm principal square root existence

leaves.scope: Linear and quadratic matrix equations (Sylvester, Lyapunov, Stein, algebraic Riccati), their solvability and the Bartels–Stewart and Hessenberg–Schur algorithms, plus Kronecker and Khatri–Rao products, the vec operator and commutation matrices.
